sents.t: It is Sunday morning.
I call my family on my computer.
In my country, it is evening, and everyone is at home.
My mother is first on the screen.
“Sam! How are you? Do you eat well?” Mothers always ask about food!
My father is next to her.
He is fifty-eight, and he is a teacher.
He has gray hair and big glasses.
“Is your apartment OK?” he asks.
“Yes, Dad. It is small, but I like it.”
Then my little sister, Mia, says hello.
She is nineteen, and she is a student at a university.
My brother, Leo, is not at home.
He works at a hospital at night.
My grandmother is there too.
She does not speak English, but she waves and smiles.
I love her very much.
“I miss you all,” I say.
“We miss you too,” my mother says.
“Call us again next Sunday!”
After the call, I feel a little sad.
Then Rosa knocks on my door with a plate of cookies.
Max is with her.
I am not alone here.

comp.q: When does Sam call his family?
comp.fa: سام کی به خانواده‌اش زنگ می‌زند؟

comp.q: Why is Leo not at home?

o: She speaks a lot of English.
